```{r}
# install.packages(c("igraph", "ggraph", "ggplot2", "tidygraph"))
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggplot2)

# Create the relationships (From -> To)
edges <- data.frame(
  from = c("Root", "Root", "Research", "Research", "Research", "Education", "Education", "Education"),
  to   = c("Research", "Education", "Continental synthesis", "Coordinated Arctic network", "Experimental tests", "Courses", "Collaboration", "Leadership")
)

# Create node details (to style different groups uniquely)
nodes <- data.frame(
  name = unique(c(edges$from, edges$to))
)
nodes$group <- ifelse(nodes$name %in% c("Root", "Research", "Education"), "Hub", "Project")

# Convert to a tidy graph object
graph <- tbl_graph(nodes = nodes, edges = edges, directed = TRUE)

ggraph(graph, layout = 'dendrogram', circular = FALSE) + 
  # Draw smooth, organic curved branching lines
  geom_edge_diagonal(aes(alpha = ..index..), color = "#7a9a60", width = 1.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  # Draw the nodes as clean, styled circles
  geom_node_point(aes(color = group, size = group), show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  # Add elegant text labels with slight offsets so they don't overlap
  geom_node_text(aes(label = name), repel = TRUE, 
                 size = 4.5, fontface = "bold", color = "#333333") +
  
  # Custom color palettes for a professional aesthetic
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Hub" = "#2c3e50", "Project" = "#e74c3c")) +
  scale_size_manual(values = c("Hub" = 8, "Project" = 4)) +
  
  # Clean up the background completely
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#fafafa", color = NA),
    plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20)
  )
```
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggraph)

# 1. Define the nodes (Entities in your story)
nodes <- tibble(
  name = c(
    # Research Progression
    "Continental\nSynthesis (Obj 1)", "Coordinated\nNetwork (Obj 2)", "Mechanistic\nExperiment (Obj 3)",
    # Education Progression
    "Foundational\nCoursework", "Independent\nResearch (SURF)", "Collaborative\nScience (Network)", "Scientific\nLeadership",
    # Core Skill sets (The glue)
    "Skill: Scientific Research", "Skill: Collaborative Science", "Skill: Observation & Comm"
  ),
  stream = c("Research", "Research", "Research", "Education", "Education", "Education", "Education", "Skill", "Skill", "Skill"),
  importance = c(3, 4, 5, 3, 4, 5, 6, 4, 4, 4) # Dictates size
)

# 2. Define the intersecting connections (Edges)
edges <- tibble(
  from = c(
    # Parallel progress rails
    "Continental\nSynthesis (Obj 1)", "Coordinated\nNetwork (Obj 2)",
    "Foundational\nCoursework", "Independent\nResearch (SURF)", "Collaborative\nScience (Network)",
    
    # Intersecting "Mycorrhizal" connections between Research & Education
    "Foundational\nCoursework", "Independent\nResearch (SURF)", 
    "Collaborative\nScience (Network)", "Scientific\nLeadership",
    
    # Mapping to Skills
    "Continental\nSynthesis (Obj 1)", "Coordinated\nNetwork (Obj 2)", "Mechanistic\nExperiment (Obj 3)",
    "Foundational\nCoursework", "Independent\nResearch (SURF)", "Collaborative\nScience (Network)", "Scientific\nLeadership"
  ),
  to = c(
    # Parallel rails links
    "Coordinated\nNetwork (Obj 2)", "Mechanistic\nExperiment (Obj 3)",
    "Independent\nResearch (SURF)", "Collaborative\nScience (Network)", "Scientific\nLeadership",
    
    # Intersecting links
    "Continental\nSynthesis (Obj 1)", "Coordinated\nNetwork (Obj 2)",
    "Coordinated\nNetwork (Obj 2)", "Mechanistic\nExperiment (Obj 3)",
    
    # Skills links
    "Skill: Scientific Research", "Skill: Collaborative Science", "Skill: Scientific Research",
    "Skill: Scientific Research", "Skill: Scientific Research", "Skill: Collaborative Science", "Skill: Observation & Comm"
  ),
  type = c(rep("Rail", 5), rep("Hyphae (Intersection)", 4), rep("Skill Link", 7))
)

# 3. Create graph object
graph <- tbl_graph(nodes = nodes, edges = edges, directed = FALSE)

# 4. Plot the intersecting network
ggraph(graph, layout = "stress") +
  # Draw intersecting lines differently than standard process lines
  geom_edge_diagonal(aes(color = type, alpha = type, width = type), show.legend = TRUE) +
  scale_edge_color_manual(values = c("Rail" = "#2c3e50", "Hyphae (Intersection)" = "#8dd3c7", "Skill Link" = "#b3de69")) +
  scale_edge_width_manual(values = c("Rail" = 1.5, "Hyphae (Intersection)" = 1, "Skill Link" = 0.8)) +
  scale_edge_alpha_manual(values = c("Rail" = 0.8, "Hyphae (Intersection)" = 0.6, "Skill Link" = 0.4)) +
  
  # Nodes styled by their stream
  geom_node_point(aes(color = stream, size = importance), show.legend = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Research" = "#225ea8", "Education" = "#41ab5d", "Skill" = "#feb24c")) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(5, 12), guide = "none") +
  
  # Clear typography that repels to avoid overlaps
  geom_node_text(aes(label = name), repel = TRUE, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", color = "#2d2d2d", box.padding = 0.6) +
  
  # Elegant, clean presentation theme
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#faf9f6", color = NA), # Soft warm background
    plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20)
  )
```
